name: Rechberghausen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically green and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rechberghausen (a red stag on white).
history: Municipal flag of Rechberghausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rechberghausen arms — red stag on white
